reasoning.step1:
I will: 
- Classify the document as an invoice by checking for invoice keywords and absence of exclusion indicators. 
- Locate invoice-level fields: invoice date, grand total, VAT rate, net and VAT amounts, sender VAT/Tax ID. 
- Verify header sections ("RECHNUNG", "Rechnungsdatum", totals) to ensure structured extraction. 
- Extract exact text/numeric values without guessing; keep decimal precision and remove percent sign from VAT rate. 
- If any required field is missing or ambiguous, leave it empty per No Inference rule.
reasoning.step2:
GrandTotal.Amount — High confidence.
- Evidence: "Zu zahlen 150,00" and "TOTAL : 150,00" and Zwischensumme 150,00; consistent across pages. Clear numeric value with currency EUR. No conflicting totals.

Invoice.Date — High confidence.
- Evidence: "Rechnungsdatum 31/03/2023" appears on page 1; same date shown in dossier lines ("Date : 31/03/2023"). Clear, unambiguous.

Sender.VatId — Medium-high confidence.
- Evidence: Page 1 shows "Btw nr.: NL800817886B01" and elsewhere "NL800817886" (in page 4 as representative Nr.). The explicit label "Btw nr." (VAT no.) with full format NL800817886B01 supports extraction. Slight ambiguity from truncated variant elsewhere but labeled VAT on page 1.

Vat.Rate — Medium confidence.
- Evidence: Page 1 shows "Mwst. 21%". However text also states "Umkehrung der Steuerschuldnerschaft" and "Befreit von Mwst. 150,00" which indicates VAT may be reversed/exempt; the presence of "Mwst. 21%" suggests a rate but its applicability to the invoice is ambiguous. Follow rule to extract rate without percent sign.

Net.Amount — Low confidence.
- Evidence: Document shows Zwischensumme 150,00 and indicates "Befreit von Mwst. 150,00" (tax-exempt), and "Zu zahlen 150,00". No explicit separate net amount labeled as "Net" is present. If invoice is VAT-exempt, Net could be 150,00 or empty per no-inference rule; ambiguity is high.

Vat.Amount — Low confidence.
- Evidence: No explicit VAT amount numeric line found (e.g., "VAT Amount 31,50"). The invoice indicates "Befreit von Mwst. 150,00" and "Mwst. 21%" but no VAT monetary value is shown. Ambiguous whether VAT amount is 0.00 or omitted; per no-inference rule should be empty unless explicitly present.
